persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a 6-second seamless loop for my website background: a calm mountain lake at dusk, with gentle ripples. Wide 16:9, camera staying still, no text or sound. Keep it subtle so I can put my own heading over it.
bank.Source image: Generate the scene; I’m not providing a photo.
bank.Visual style and mood: Realistic, peaceful mountain lake at dusk, with subdued colours.
bank.Motion and looping: Gentle water ripples, a fixed camera, and no visible jump when it repeats.
bank.Size and placement: Wide 16:9 website background; keep the centre calm enough for my own heading.

messages.text: Could you make a seamless loop for my website background showing a calm mountain lake at dusk, with gentle ripples on the water? I’ve been thinking about the site a lot, and I’m hoping this will help it feel a little more welcoming. It should be 6 seconds long and wide 16:9, with the camera staying still throughout. I tend to overthink how background visuals will look once everything else is on the page. Please don’t include any text or sound, and keep the whole thing subtle so I can put my own heading over it.
